children: RBC Capital raised its price target on Datadog

to $320 from $280 and kept an Outperform rating. It also lifted its third-quarter revenue growth forecast for the observability software company to 34% to 35% from 28.7%. Datadog shares fell 1.30% as of 10:45 a.m. ET.

That would be a slight slowdown from the 36% growth Datadog reported for the second quarter, when revenue reached $1.12 billion. The company has guided third-quarter revenue to $1.135 billion to $1.145 billion.

RBC said its estimates build in more caution around OpenAI after observed declines in usage, and that third and fourth-quarter numbers could rise further if those trends reverse or ease. Datadog flagged a similar risk in its quarterly filing, saying its largest customer began reducing usage in the third quarter, which may slow revenue growth. It didn't name the customer.

title: Datadog Stock Gets $320 RBC Target on Higher Growth Forecast
